_comment: Risk-calibration golden vectors — the false-positive/false-negative corpus.
Two-sided contract: every 'benign' vector must score AT/BELOW its max_risk in
every layer it covers; every 'risky' vector must score AT/ABOVE its min_risk.
Bounds, not exact totals: intentional tuning may move scores inside the band;
drifting past a bound is a calibration regression and fails CI.
app/lib/guard.ts computeRiskScore (server). The guard takes max(client, server),
so a false positive in EITHER layer interrupts an agent.
TO ADD A CASE: when an interruption is judged wrong (or a dangerous action
scores low), add a vector here with source naming the incident, set the bound,
fix the model if warranted, and ship both in the same commit.
